results.observation: Paired-pixel median coherence change was -0.1313 in the preliminary detachment polygon versus +0.1841 in the local control ring.
results.validation: Independent preliminary optical detachment polygon, temporal null pair, local ring, and control-calibrated 5th-percentile/MMU mask.

false_alarm_accounting.reference_role: preliminary independent optical detachment polygon; not field ground truth
false_alarm_accounting.control_definition: valid land pixels in analysis bbox outside a 300 m detachment buffer
false_alarm_accounting.threshold_rule: 0.050 lower quantile of control event-minus-quiet coherence
limitations: The HyP3 burst bundle supplied water/nodata masks but no explicit layover-shadow mask; steep-terrain geometry remains an unresolved censoring issue.
The threshold is calibrated to this one temporal null/event comparison and is not a transferable hazard threshold.
Coherence loss is an observable, not unique evidence of movement; snow, moisture, surface disruption, atmosphere, and processing differences remain possible.
The map is retrospective screening support, not a forecast or operational warning product.

results.interpretation: Localized event-spanning coherence loss is supported; unique cause, precursor motion, displacement, and prediction are not.

results.observation: Event-pair source phase coverage fell to 9 of 528 80 m pixels (1.70%), while the exploratory control retained 420 of 420.
results.validation: Quiet pair, spatial control, track-48 alternative-look test, encoded masks, connected components, and ionosphere flags.
results.interpretation: No defensible LOS displacement or pre-event rate is reported.

results.observation: Raw, unculled event-source GOFF layer-1 offsets had correlation median 0.2206 and extreme p05/p95 ranges of hundreds of metres.
results.validation: Quiet and control subsets were processed with the same range-read code; control correlation remained about 0.86.
results.interpretation: The raw layers cannot support a sub-metre subtle-motion claim without culling, stable-reference modeling, and uncertainty estimation.

results.observation: Event-source HH gamma-0 change widened to p05/p95 −6.69/+5.77 dB, while the event control was −3.19/+3.14 dB.
results.validation: Matched quiet and control windows were range-read from provisional GCOV products.
results.interpretation: This is calibrated backscatter change only; it is not classified as debris, water, or movement.
